description: This file contains test cases for the transcript-tools module, testing functions like extractToolCallNames, hasToolCall, and countToolResults using the vitest testing framework.

methods.name: extractToolCallNames
methods.description: Extracts tool call names from message objects with various content structures and normalizes inputs.

methods.name: hasToolCall
methods.description: Determines whether a given message object contains any tool call references.

methods.name: countToolResults
methods.description: Counts the number of tool result blocks and error blocks within message content.
